observations.description: Prior sensor entry copied 'Local Python 3.12 spawn processes; no independent administration or external resource. GitHub observations via connected API.' This mixes the brake experiment environment with the monitored sensor's execution environment.

Corrected monitored environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner with setup-python configured for Python 3.12. The review used GitHub API job/log/artifact metadata. No local sensor execution or independent custody is claimed.
Correction changes environment attribution only. Historical two HTTP403 failures, scope reduction and manual success remain separately supported; scheduled reliability and delivery remain unobserved.
